blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Face forgery detection methods often perform well on seen manipulations but generalize poorly to unseen ones. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. Existing MLLM-based methods typically express these judgments through textual explanations, but seldom treat individual part decisions as explicit learning targets. We present FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Following the Jev formulation, FaceJev answers eight independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding and reads anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal, directly linking the detection result to the part decisions. We construct PartForensics, a dataset of approximately 160k images with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, to supervise these decisions. We further propose FS-GRPO, which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. FaceJev outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations. Extensive ablation studies validate our design choices and the effectiveness of the main components.
blocks.zh: 伪造相貌的侦测方法往往在所见的操纵下表现良好,但被概括到不为人所见。 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)可以识别面部部分并评估其视觉可信度. 现有的基于MLLM的方法通常通过文字解释来表达这些判断,但很少将个别部分的决定作为明确的学习目标来对待. 我们介绍FaceJev,一种基于MLLM的方法,通过直接的视觉判断来检测假相. 遵循Jev配方,FaceJev用共享的图像编码解答了8个关于面部部分的独立问题,并读取了从原生的答案日志中得出的异常概率. 如果任何部分被预测为异常,一面被归类为伪造,直接将检测结果与部分决定联系起来. 我们构建了Pat Forensics, 一个大约160克图像的数据集, 并有八个面部的二进制异常目标, 监督这些决定。 我们进一步提议FS-GRPO,它通过精确的奖励与其备选方法进行比较,利用检测和部分奖励来优化每个部分的决定。 FaceJev在隐形操纵上比最强的基线业绩高出7.25个百分点. 广泛的消化研究验证了我们的设计选择和主要组成部分的有效性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Face forgery detection helps safeguard information integrity and public trust by identifying manipulated facial content. Existing methods can achieve high accuracy on seen manipulations, yet their performance often drops substantially on unseen ones [ 30 , 40 ] . New methods for face swapping, reenactment, talking face generation, and diffusion editing can produce artifacts that differ from those represented in training data. Reliable detection therefore requires generalization to manipulation methods unseen in the training data.

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility, including abnormalities such as fused teeth, mismatched irises, or blurred lip boundaries. Existing MLLM-based methods incorporate these capabilities into detection through textual explanations [ 38 , 23 ] or forensic reasoning [ 32 , 14 ] . Training on textual explanations supervises both the visual judgments and the wording used to express them, although generating that wording is not required to determine whether a facial part is abnormal. Individual part decisions are seldom treated as explicit learning targets that directly determine the detection result for the input image.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)可以识别面部部分并评估其视觉上的合理性,包括假牙等异常,错配的虹膜,或唇边界模糊等. 现有的基于MLLM的方法通过文字解释[38、23]或法证推理[32、14]将这些能力纳入检测。 关于文字解释的培训既监督视觉判断,也监督用来表达这些判断的措辞,尽管产生这种措辞并不需要来确定面部部分是否不正常. 个别部分的决定很少被视为直接决定输入图像检测结果的明确学习目标。

blocks.en: To learn these part decisions directly, we introduce FaceJev , an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Our design builds on Jev [ 35 ] and Visual Jev [ 41 ] , in which independent questions share a context and answer probabilities are read from the native answer logits. For facial analysis, we use a shared image encoding and two answer options per question, allowing the model to assign an anomaly probability to each part. These probabilities are then combined through a fixed rule to predict whether the input face image is real or forged.
blocks.zh: 为了直接学习这些部分的决定,我们引入了FaceJev,一种基于MLLM的方法,通过直接的视觉决定来进行面部伪造检测. 我们的设计基于Jev [35] 和Visual Jev [41],其中独立问题共享上下文,答案概率从原生的回答日志读取. 对于面部分析,我们使用一个共享的图像编码和每个问题的两个答案选项,使模型可以给每个部分分配一个异常概率. 这些概率随后通过固定规则进行组合,以预测输入面相图像是真实的还是被伪造的.

blocks.en: FaceJev asks eight independent questions, one each about the eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin, hair, ears, and facial regions. Every question observes the full image and returns an anomaly probability for the named part. The detection score is the largest of the eight probabilities, so a face is classified as forged if any anomaly probability reaches 0.5 ( Fig. 1 ). This is equivalent to applying OR to the part decisions obtained at the same threshold. The image prediction is thus determined by the part decisions, which are learned through direct supervision and refined through policy optimization using both detection and part rewards.
blocks.zh: FaceJev提出了8个独立的问题,分别涉及眼睛,眉毛,鼻子,口腔,皮肤,发型,耳朵和面部区域. 每个问题都观察完整的图像,并返回命名部分的异常概率. 探测分数是8个概率中最大的,所以如果任何异常概率达到0.5(图一.),面被归类为伪造. 这相当于对在同一起点上获得的部分决定适用OR。 因此,图像预测是由部分决定决定的,这些决定通过直接监督来学习,并通过利用检测和部分奖励来优化政策来加以完善。

blocks.en: Learning these decisions requires a target for every question. Image labels supervise only the final prediction, while judgments about the visual plausibility of individual facial parts remain implicit in existing textual explanations. We therefore construct PartForensics , a dataset with explicit binary anomaly targets for eight facial parts. We use existing textual explanations as references when annotating each facial part in the images. PartForensics contains approximately 160k real and forged images covering nine manipulation methods, with 1.27 million part targets aligned with the FaceJev questions. These targets directly supervise the part decisions, define the part reward, and support evaluation of the predicted anomalies across all eight facial parts.
blocks.zh: 了解这些决定要求每个问题都有一个目标。 图像标签只监督最终预测,而对于单个面部部分的视觉可信度的判断仍然隐含在现有文字解释中. 因此,我们构建了 PartForensics, 一个数据集 明确二进制异常目标 8个面部部分。 我们用已有的文字解释作为参考, PartForensics包含约160k真实和伪造的图像,涵盖9个操纵方法,127万个部分目标与FaceJev问题一致. 这些目标直接监督部分决定,定义部分奖励,并支持评价所有8个面部部分的预测异常.

blocks.en: After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we use policy optimization with detection and part rewards to jointly optimize image classification and part decisions. Applying standard GRPO [ 29 ] directly would assign each sampled output a single advantage based on its reward relative to the other outputs in the group. This advantage would be shared across the entire output, without distinguishing the contributions of its individual decisions. To provide feedback for each part decision, we propose Forensic State-aware GRPO (FS-GRPO) , which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. For each sampled vector, we flip one part decision while keeping the other seven fixed and compare the resulting reward with the original reward to obtain its individual advantage. Because the rewards depend only on the binary decisions and their targets, both choices are evaluated exactly without another forward pass.
blocks.zh: 经过监督的微调(SFT)后,我们利用有检测和部分奖励的政策优化,共同优化图像分类和部分决策. 采用标准GRPO[29]将直接为每个抽样产出分配单一优势,其依据是相对于该组中其他产出的奖励。 这一优势将在整个产出中共享,而不区分其个别决定的贡献。 为了对每一部分的决定提供反馈,我们提议采用国家-GRPO(FS-GRPO)法证法,通过精确的奖励与备选方法比较,利用检测和部分奖励,优化每一部分的决定。 对于每个抽样的矢量,我们翻转一个部分的决定,同时保留另外七个部分,并将所得的奖励与原始奖励进行比较,以获得其个人优势. 由于奖励只取决于二进制决定及其目标,所以对两种选择都进行准确的评价,而不会有另一个前行。

blocks.en: In conclusion, the main contributions of this paper are: • FaceJev , an MLLM-based method that detects face forgeries through direct visual decisions on eight facial parts, using independent questions on a shared image encoding and anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. • PartForensics , a dataset of 159,144 images covering nine manipulation methods with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, supporting supervision, rewards, and evaluation of part decisions in face forgery detection. • FS-GRPO , a policy optimization method that optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using the detection and part rewards.
blocks.zh: 最后,本文的主要贡献是: ^ FaceJev,一种基于MLLM的方法,通过8个面部的直接视觉决定来检测面部造假,使用来自原生答案日志的共享图像编码和异常概率的独立问题. • PartForensics,由159 144个图像组成的数据集,涵盖8个面部部分的有二进制异常目标的9个操纵方法,支持监督、奖励和评价部分决定。 • FS-GRPO,一种政策优化方法,利用检测和部分奖励,通过精确的奖励与替代方法进行比较,优化每个部分的决定。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Face forgery detectors seek visual cues that generalize across manipulation methods. Face X-ray detects blending boundaries [ 12 ] , F3-Net mines frequency-aware forgery clues [ 25 ] , SBI synthesizes training examples through self-blending [ 30 ] , and LAA-Net attends to localized artifacts [ 21 ] . More recent methods learn or adapt pretrained visual representations. Forensics Adapter adapts CLIP [ 27 ] for face forgery detection [ 1 ] . UDD suppresses biased cues through token shuffling and mixing [ 5 ] , FSFM learns facial representations through self-supervised pretraining [ 36 ] , and Effort constrains adaptation to an orthogonal subspace to preserve pretrained knowledge [ 39 ] . GenD targets transfer across benchmarks [ 40 ] , while DiCoME combines multiple views through evidential learning [ 9 ] . These methods learn visual features for image classification. FaceJev instead learns explicit part decisions through independent questions.
blocks.zh: 面部伪造探测器寻找可通用各种操纵方法的视觉提示. Face X-ray探测到混合边界[12],F3-Net地雷频率-认识伪造线索[25],履行机构通过自混合[30]综合培训实例,LAA-Net关注本地化文物[21]. 更近的方法学习或调整预先训练的视觉表现. 法证适配器可改用CLIP [27]来进行面部伪造检测 [1]. UDD通过符号洗牌和混合来压制有偏见的提示 [5],FSFM通过自我监督的预训来学习面部表现 [36],而"努力"则制约了对正弦子空间的适应,以保存预训知识 [39]. GenD目标跨越基准转移[40],而DiCoME通过证据学习结合了多种观点[9]. 这些方法学习图像分类的视觉特征. FaceJev转而通过独立问题学习明确的部分决定.

blocks.en: MLLMs can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. M2F2-Det uses a visual detector to guide textual explanation generation [ 6 ] , while FakeVLM learns image predictions and artifact explanations [ 38 ] . VLF-FFD fuses visual features from a forgery detector with textual representations from an MLLM through bidirectional cross-attention [ 23 ] . VERITAS optimizes pattern-aware reasoning with reinforcement learning [ 32 ] , VIGIL grounds structured reasoning in facial parts and rewards its intermediate evidence [ 14 ] , and VRAG-DFD retrieves verifiable references to support detection [ 7 ] . These methods typically express facial judgments through text, with supervision covering both the judgments and their wording. Individual part decisions are seldom treated as explicit learning targets. Jev [ 35 ] and Visual Jev [ 41 ] provide a direct decision formulation in which independent questions share a context and probabilities for a constrained set of answers are read from the native answer logits. FaceJev applies this formulation to eight facial parts and utilizes OR for the final prediction.
blocks.zh: MLLMs可以识别面部部分并评估其视觉可信度. M2F2-Det使用可视探测器来引导文字解释生成[6],而"假VLM"则学习图像预测和文物解释[38]. VLF-FFD通过双向交叉注意,从伪造探测器上引信出视觉特征,并带有MLLM的文字表述[23]. VERITAS通过强化学习优化了模式-意识推理[32],VIGIL基于面部部分的结构推理并奖励了它的中间证据[14],而VRAG-DFD检索了可核实的引用以支持检测[7]. 这些方法通常通过文字表达面部判断,同时监督判决及其措辞。 个别部分的决定很少被视为明确的学习目标。 Jev [35]和Visual Jev [41]提供了一种直接的决策表述,其中独立问题共享一个上下文,对一组受限制的答案的概率从原生答案日志读取. FaceJev将这种配方应用于8个面部部分,并使用OR进行最终预测.

blocks.en: Benchmarks such as FaceForensics++ [ 28 ] and Celeb-DF [ 15 ] provide image or video labels, and AI-Face scales labeled generated faces to a million images [ 17 ] . Richer annotations have followed with the rise of MLLM-based methods. DD-VQA poses common-sense questions about deepfakes [ 42 ] , FFTG supplies structured descriptions of manipulated regions [ 31 ] , HydraFake provides textual explanations across diverse manipulation methods [ 32 ] , and MMTT pairs manipulated faces with attribution reports [ 16 ] . However, judgments about the visual plausibility of individual facial parts remain embedded in textual explanations. PartForensics uses FFTG descriptions and MMTT attribution reports to guide annotation of the eight facial parts, providing binary anomaly targets for supervision, the part reward, and evaluation of part decisions.
blocks.zh: FaceForensics++ [28] 和 Celeb-DF [15] 等基准提供图像或视频标签,AI-Face平面标注生成的面值为一百万个图像[17]. 更丰富的说明紧随其后是基于MLLM的方法的兴起. DD-VQA提出了关于深层假象的常识性问题[42],FFTG供应对被操纵区域的结构化描述[31],Hydra 假说提供了不同操纵方法的文字解释[32],而MMTT被操纵的相片有归属报告[16]. 然而,对于单个面部部分的视觉可信度的判断仍然被嵌入到文字解释中. PartForensics使用FFTG描述和MMTT归属报告来指导对8个面部部分的注释,为监督,部分奖励,以及部分决定的评价提供二进制异常目标.

blocks.en: 3.1 Detection through Direct Visual Decisions
blocks.zh: 3.1 通过直接视觉决定进行检测

blocks.en: Given a face image x x , the goal is to predict its label y ∈ { 0 , 1 } y\in\{0,1\} , where 0 denotes a real image and 1 denotes a forgery. Following the Jev formulation [ 35 , 41 ] , FaceJev answers independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding. We read anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits, without generating any textual explanations.

blocks.en: We use K = 8 K=8 fixed questions q 1 , … , q K q_{1},\ldots,q_{K} for the eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin, hair, ears, and facial regions. The last category covers the forehead, cheeks, chin, and jaw. Each question uses A for no and B for yes. The eye question asks whether the eyes or pupils show visible signs of manipulation. Every question observes the full image, and no answer is used to predict another. Evidence for different parts can overlap, so a texture defect on the nose bridge may lead to abnormal predictions for both the nose and the skin.

blocks.en: After FS-SFT, we use policy optimization with detection and part rewards to jointly optimize image classification and part decisions. Applying standard GRPO [ 29 ] directly in this setting would assign each sampled vector one advantage based on its total reward relative to the other vectors for the same image. All decisions in that vector would share the advantage, even when some match their targets and others do not. FS-GRPO optimizes each part decision within each sampled vector through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards.
blocks.zh: 在FS-SFT之后,我们利用带有检测和部分奖励的政策优化,共同优化图像分类和部分决策. 在此设置中直接应用标准的 GRPO [29] 将根据其相对于其他矢量对同一图像的总回报来分配每个被抽样的矢量一个优势. 这一载体中的所有决定都具有相同优势,即使有些决定与目标相符,而另一些决定则不然。 FS-GRPO通过精确的奖励与其替代品的比较,利用检测和部分奖励,优化了每个抽样矢量中的每个部分的决定.

blocks.en: PartForensics provides binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts to supervise the direct visual decisions in FaceJev. Each sample consists of a face image x x , its real/fake label y y , and eight binary anomaly targets 𝐞 \mathbf{e} aligned with the independent part questions. The targets supervise the part decisions in FS-SFT, define the part reward in FS-GRPO, and enable evaluation of part decisions on Seen test images.
blocks.zh: PartForensics为8个面部部分提供二进制异常目标来监督FaceJev中的直接视觉决定. 每个样本由面相图像 xx,其真实/假标签 y y 组成,并有八个二进制异常目标 e\ mathbf{e} 与独立部分问题对齐. 目标监督FS-SFT中的部分决定,界定FS-GRPO中的部分奖励,并能够评价Seen测试图像中的部分决定。

blocks.en: We obtain binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts by inspecting images with existing textual explanations as references. We use FaceForensics++ [ 28 ] images with structured FFTG [ 31 ] descriptions and MMTT [ 16 ] images with attribution reports. We select these sources because the annotation procedures of FFTG and MMTT are well suited to identifying forgery artifacts in facial parts, making their explanations useful references for part annotation. MMTT contains only forged images, so we supplement this component with real faces from CelebAMask-HQ [ 11 ] and FFHQ [ 10 ] . For forged images from both sources, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [ 2 ] inspects each image together with its explanation. It checks whether the described abnormalities are visible in the corresponding facial parts and also examines parts not mentioned in the text. The model assigns a binary anomaly target to each of the eight parts, with 0 for normal and 1 for abnormal. Real images receive all-zero part targets. At detection time, FaceJev receives only the image and fixed questions. Further annotation details are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们用现有的文字解释来检查图像作为参考,从而获得八个面部部分的二进制异常目标. 我们使用FaceForensics+ [28] 有结构化 FFTG [31] 描述的图像和 MMTT [16] 有归属报告的图像. 我们选择这些来源是因为FFTG和MMTT的注释程序非常适合识别面部部分的伪造文物,使得其解释对部分注释很有用. MMTT只包含被伪造的图像,所以我们用来自Celebamask-HQ[11]和FFHQ[10]的真实面孔来补充这个组件. 对于来自两个来源的伪造图像,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [2] 检查每个图像及其解释. 它检查所描述的异常现象在相应的面部部分是否可见,还检查了文本中没有提到的部分. 该模型为8个部分中的每个部分指定了二进制异常目标,其中正常部分为0个,异常部分为1个. 真实图像接收全零部分目标. 在检测时间,FaceJev只接收图像和固定的问题. 补充材料中提供了进一步的注释细节。

blocks.en: To evaluate generalization, we use a separate Unseen test set of 30,475 images with image labels only ( Fig. 3 (b)). It includes 17 manipulation methods absent from training across six categories: face swapping, face reenactment, talking faces, face synthesis, local editing, and regional manipulation. blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: We first describe the experimental setup ( Sec. 5.1 ) and compare detection performance on Seen and Unseen manipulations ( Sec. 5.2 ). Ablation studies examine the contributions of FS-SFT and FS-GRPO ( Sec. 5.3 ), followed by a comparison of part supervision across backbones ( Sec. 5.4 ). We also assess part prediction quality using quantitative metrics and visual examples ( Sec. 5.5 ) and compare inference cost alongside detection performance across methods ( Sec. 5.6 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: All trained models use the 66,914 images of the PartForensics training split. Seen evaluation uses the 78,950 Seen test images of the nine training methods, and Unseen evaluation uses the 30,475 images of the 17 unseen manipulation methods described in Sec. 4 . We report balanced accuracy (BACC), the mean of the true positive and true negative rates, at a fixed threshold of 0.5. Seen Mean averages the nine methods equally. For Unseen, we average source subsets within each method and methods within each category, and Unseen Mean weights the six categories equally. Avg is the mean of Seen Mean and Unseen Mean. We also report Part ACC and Part AUC for FaceJev against the binary anomaly targets of the Seen test images.
blocks.zh: 所有训练有素的模型都使用PartForensics训练的66,914相片分出. 视评价采用78 950美元 看到了九种训练方法的测试图像,而"幽灵"评价则使用了第4节所描述的17种隐形操控方法的30,475个图像. 我们报告说,准确性(BACC)是真实正负率的平均值,定值为0.5。 平均看9种方法的平均值相等。 就“不明”而言,我们在每个类别内每种方法中的平均源子集,“不明”平均权重为6个类别。 Avg是"见相"和"见相"的"见相"的取向. 我们还针对Seen测试图像的二进制异常目标,报告FaceJev的ACC部分和AUC部分。

FS-SFT achieves the highest Unseen Mean among supervision variants in panel (a), while FS-GRPO leads all six categories in panel (b).

blocks.en: We compare FaceJev with five visual detectors, UDD [ 5 ] , FSFM [ 36 ] , Effort [ 39 ] , GenD [ 40 ] , and DiCoME [ 9 ] , and two MLLM-based methods, FakeVLM [ 38 ] and VERITAS [ 32 ] . These methods are trained on our training split with their default settings and evaluated on the same test images. We also evaluate three models without training on this task, including Qwen3.5-4B [ 26 ] , Visual Jev [ 41 ] , and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了FaceJev的5个视觉探测器,UDD [5],FSFM [36],努力[39],GenD [40]和DiCoME [9],以及基于MLLM的两种方法:假VLM [38]和VERITAS [32]. 这些方法在我们的训练中经过了培训,与默认设置分开,并在同一测试图像上进行评估。 我们还评价三个没有接受过此项任务培训的模型,包括:Quen3.5-4B [26],Visual Jev [41],和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [2].

blocks.en: FaceJev adapts the vision and language components of Qwen3.5-4B [ 26 ] with LoRA [ 8 ] of rank 128 and scaling 256, at a 512 × \times 512 pixel budget, and keeps the vision-language merger frozen. Training uses AdamW [ 20 ] , BF16, and a global batch of 128 images on eight A100 80GB GPUs. FS-SFT trains for two epochs with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . FS-GRPO then trains for one epoch with a fresh optimizer, learning rates of 10 − 6 10^{-6} and 10 − 5 10^{-5} for the vision and language components, respectively, and G = 8 G=8 sampled state vectors per image. Additional training details are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: FaceJev以128级并缩放256的LORA[8]来调整Quen3.5-4B[26]的视觉和语言组件,以512×\times 512像素预算,并保持视觉-语言合并被冻结. 训练使用 AdamW [20], BF16,以及八台A100 80GB GPU上一批全球128幅图像. FS-SFT列车为两节编组,学习速率为5×10-5 5\times 10×5}. FS-GRPO随后为一时代进行训练,新优化器,视觉和语言组件的学习率分别为10−6 10^{-6}和10−5 10^{-5},而每幅图像的G=8 G=8抽样状态矢量. 补充材料中提供了其他培训细节。

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that FaceJev achieves the highest Seen Mean BACC of 97.53% and an Unseen Mean BACC of 84.23%, outperforming the strongest baseline on Unseen methods by 7.25 percentage points. Although the MLLM-based methods FakeVLM and VERITAS perform well on Seen manipulations, their Unseen scores fall to 74.09% and 73.17%, respectively, well below FaceJev. These comparisons demonstrate the effectiveness of learning explicit part decisions for generalizable face forgery detection. Notably, models without task training reach 49.33%–54.40% Unseen Mean BACC, with Visual Jev at 52.83% using the same eight questions. The interface alone does not solve the task, and the following ablations examine how to learn the part decisions.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,FaceJev的可见平均值为97.53%,不明平均值为84.23%,比不明方法的最强基线高出7.25个百分点。 虽然基于MLLM的方法"假VLM"和"VERITAS"在Seen操控上表现良好,但其"不明"分数分别下降到74.09%和73.17%,远低于FaceJev. 这些比较表明,学习明确的部分决定对一般性的假相检测是有效的。 值得注意的是,未接受任务培训的型号达到49.33-54.40%的不明平均值BACC,而Visual Jev为52.83%,使用同样的八个问题。 单靠界面无法解决任务,下面的活化会研究如何学习部分决定.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2 (a) compares five ways of supervising Qwen3.5-4B. Binary SFT trains the model to answer real or fake and reaches 78.57%. Adding textual explanations to image-label supervision gives 78.02%. FS-SFT directly supervises the eight part decisions with binary anomaly targets and reaches 80.84%, 2.27 and 2.82 points above these alternatives, without supervising an image-level answer. Both design choices of FS-SFT contribute. Packing all eight questions into one sequence lowers Unseen Mean by 3.12 points, supporting the use of independent questions on a shared image encoding. Removing the positive weighting lowers Unseen Mean by 2.40 points, supporting the use of class weighting to account for the imbalance between normal and abnormal targets for each of the eight facial parts.
blocks.zh: 表2(a)比较了监督Quen3.5-4B的五种方式。 二进制SFT训练该型号以回答真假,并达到78.57%. 在图像标签监管中添加文字解释给出78.02%. FS-SFT直接监督有二进制异常目标的8个部分的决定,并在这些替代品之上达到80.84%,2.27和2.82分,而没有监督图像级别的答案. FS-SFT的设计选择都作出了贡献。 将所有8个问题打入一个序列将Unseen Mean降低3.12分,支持在共享图像编码上使用独立问题. 将正重下分去除 2.40分的Un Seenn Meal,支持使用类重分来核算8个面部各部分正常和异常目标之间的不平衡.

blocks.en: Table 2 (b) compares policy optimization variants. FS-GRPO raises Unseen Mean from 80.84% to 84.23% and improves every category, by 1.47 to 4.34 points. Standard GRPO, which shares one advantage across a sample, reaches 82.97%. FS-GRPO surpasses it by 1.26 points on average and in all six categories, supporting the optimization of individual part decisions through exact partwise reward comparisons. Both detection and part rewards contribute. Without the part reward, optimization relies on detection rewards alone, and Unseen Mean falls to 83.29%. Without the detection reward, optimization uses only agreement with part targets, and it falls to 82.29%. The full method outperforms both variants in every category. Running FS-GRPO from the base model reaches only 63.75%, supporting the use of FS-SFT to initialize the part decisions before policy optimization with the two rewards.
blocks.zh: 表2(b)比较了政策优化变式。 FS-GROPO将不明平均值从80.84%提高到84.23%,并且将每个类别提高1.47至4.34分。 标准GRPO在样本中拥有一个优势,达到82.97%. FS-GRPO平均超过1.26分,在所有6个类别中,支持通过精确的部分奖励比较来优化个别部分的决定。 侦测和部分奖励都有贡献。 没有部分奖励,优化仅依靠检测奖励,而Unseen Mean跌至83.29%. 没有检测奖励,优化只使用与部分目标的协议,降为82.29%. 整个方法在每一个类别中都超过了两个变体. 从基准模式运行的FS-GRPO只达到63.75%,支持使用FS-SFT在政策优化前以两种奖励来初始化部分决定.

blocks.en: 5.4 Part Supervision across Backbones
blocks.zh: 5.4 对后骨的监管

blocks.en: To compare the effects of part supervision across backbones, we train two visual encoders, ConvNeXt-B [ 18 ] and ViT-B/16 [ 4 ] , initialized from ImageNet [ 3 ] pretraining and fine-tuned in full at 512 × \times 512 resolution. For each backbone, the Binary and Parts variants use the same training settings. The Binary model predicts the image label with a single logit, while the Parts model predicts the eight PartForensics targets with eight logits from one pooled feature. The Parts model uses the weights in Eq. 3 for supervision and the max/OR rule in Eq. 2 for image classification. This comparison follows the same distinction between Binary SFT and FS-SFT on the Qwen3.5-4B backbone used in FaceJev.
blocks.zh: 为了比较部分监管跨主干线的效果,我们培训了两个视觉编码器,ConvNEXt-B [18]和Vit-B/16 [4],从ImageNet[3]预训中初始化,以512x\times 512分辨率全程进行微调. 对于每个骨干,二进制和零件变体使用相同的训练设置. 二进制模型以单一的对数预测图像标签,而Parts模型则以一个集合特性的8个对数预测了PartForensics目标. Parts模型使用Eq. 3中的权重进行监管,而Eq. 2中的最大/OR规则用于图像分类. 这一比较遵循了FaceJev中使用的Quen3.5-4B主干上二进制SFT和FS-SFT的相同区别.

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that the effect of part supervision depends on the backbone. It lowers Unseen BACC by 3.08 and 3.30 percentage points on ConvNeXt-B and ViT-B/16, respectively, but improves it by 2.27 points on Qwen3.5-4B. The visual encoders predict all eight targets from one pooled feature, whereas FaceJev answers independent questions about the named facial parts using a shared image encoding. These results support using explicit part questions to adapt the facial knowledge of an MLLM for forgery detection. Applying FS-GRPO after FS-SFT yields a further gain of 3.39 percentage points, supporting policy optimization for refining the part decisions learned through supervision.
blocks.zh: 表3显示部分监管的效果取决于主干. 它在ConvNEXt-B和Vit-B/16上分别将Unseen BACC降低了3.08和3.30个百分点,但在Quen3.5-4B上提高了2.27个百分点. 视觉编码器从一个集合特性中预测出所有8个目标,而FaceJev则使用共享的图像编码来解答关于被命名的面部部分的独立问题. 这些结果支持使用明确的部分问题来调整MLLM的面部知识来进行伪造检测. 在FS-SFT之后适用FS-GRPO,可进一步增加3.39个百分点,支持政策优化,以完善通过监督学到的决定。

blocks.en: 5.5 Quality of the Part Decisions
blocks.zh: 5.5 决定部分的质量

blocks.en: We evaluate the eight part decisions against the binary anomaly targets in PartForensics ( Tab. 4 ). FaceJev reaches 89.04% Part ACC and 94.94% Part AUC, showing that most part decisions agree with the annotated targets and that the predicted probabilities distinguish normal from abnormal parts effectively. Part AUC exceeds 89% for every Seen manipulation method, supporting the effectiveness of the part predictions across all nine methods. Overall, part prediction performance is stronger on the four FaceForensics++ methods, Deepfakes, Face2Face, FaceSwap, and NeuralTextures, than on the MMTT methods, E4S, MAT, SDXL, StyleCLIP, and HFGI, in terms of the Part ACC and Part AUC metrics.

blocks.en: Table 5 compares FaceJev with FakeVLM and VERITAS, followed by the Binary SFT and Explanation SFT ablations. FakeVLM and VERITAS produce both a binary score and a textual explanation, processing 2.93 and 2.39 images per second, respectively. Among the SFT variants, Binary SFT is fastest at 14.60 images per second because it returns only a binary score, while Explanation SFT processes 1.28 images per second with explanation generation included. With a shared image encoding, FaceJev predicts anomaly probabilities for all eight facial parts and uses the maximum as the image detection score. It processes 8.71 images per second without generating textual explanations. It is faster than every compared method except Binary SFT and achieves the highest Unseen BACC of 84.23%, offering a favorable balance between its detection performance and inference cost.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Eight independent questions about facial parts use a shared image encoding of the full input image, with anomaly probabilities read from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal. PartForensics provides binary anomaly targets for supervising these decisions, and FS-GRPO optimizes each decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. Ablations support these design choices. FaceJev achieves the highest Seen and Unseen Mean BACC among the compared methods, surpassing the strongest Unseen baseline by 7.25 percentage points. It also provides faster inference than the compared methods that generate textual explanations. These results demonstrate the potential of FaceJev for face forgery detection.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了FaceJev,一种基于MLLM的方法,通过直接的视觉判断来检测假相. 关于面部部分的8个独立问题使用完整输入图像的共享图像编码,异常概率从原生的答案日志读取. 如果任何部分被预测为异常,脸被归类为伪造. PartForensics为监督这些决定提供了二进制异常目标,FS-GRPO通过精确的奖励与其替代品的比较来优化每个决定,同时使用检测和部分奖励. 缩写支持这些设计选择. FaceJev在比较方法中实现了最高的可见和不明平均值BACC,超过最强的不明基线7.25个百分点. 它还提供了比产生文字解释的比较方法更快的推论. 这些结果显示了FaceJev检测假相的潜力.
